title: Summit Club Lounge Uplift on Crestline Companion Phone Fee Refunds
content:
Holders of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes with an active membership in Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships have a phone booking fee refund raised by a lounge uplift, which follows the holder's active Summit Club product:

| Holder's active Summit Club product | Lounge uplift |
|---|---|
| Summit Club Executive or Summit Club Lifetime | adds 10 percent |
| Summit Club Individual or Summit Club Individual Plus | adds 5 percent |
| no active membership, or any other club product | adds nothing |

Only a Summit Club membership in active status is read.

**Hypothetical case.** An active Summit Club Individual Plus member receives an uplift of 5 percent; a holder whose Summit Club Executive membership is cancelled receives none.
